title: BACC: banking app-like reporting and accounting

ms.promise:
The BACC for Cardano project will focus on designing and developing an adapter module to make BACC available to Cardano users. 
This milestone focuses on developing the backend components necessary for integrating BACC with the Cardano blockchain. Key components include the Cardano adapter interface, transaction collector, token list collector, token price collector, NFT support, and REST API.
・Cardano adapter interface.
・Transaction, token list, and token price collectors.
・NFT support.
・REST API (OpenAPI interface).
ms.criteria:
・Integration and functionality of the Cardano adapter interface with the Cardano blockchain.
・Collection and processing of transaction and token data.
・Support of NFT.
・Functioning of REST API.
ms.report:
Hello Cardano Team,
First, an important notice: BACC has been renamed to JPool Insights (however, some repos, etc. may have the old name).
We have prepared the following deliverables for this PoA:
・Video demonstrating that JPool Insights is integrated with the Cardano blockchain, collects and processes transaction and token data, supports NFT, and has a functioning REST API. Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ClUIq13RU5lRbhetbnj79XhM55ZCkt5v/view?usp=sharing 
・ Public repo: https://github.com/mfactory-lab/bacc-cardano
・MVP: https://dev.bacc.one/
・Documentation: https://mfactory-lab.gitbook.io/jpool-insights 

If you have any questions or there is something that we might have missed, please let us know. Thank you!
Sincerely, 
Vladdy and the jFactory Team

・Cardano wallet integrated with frontend.

ms.criteria:
・Integration of the Cardano wallet with frontend.
・Integration of Cardano-specific web components.
・Integration of REST API with frontend.

ms.promise:
This milestone involves the finalization of the BACC for Cardano project, including preparation and submission of a Project Closeout Report and a Project Closeout Video.
・The fully open-source BACC for Cardano project (adapter) licensed under AGPLv3.
・Project Closeout Report outlining the development process, challenges encountered, and solutions implemented.
・Project Closeout Video presenting BACC's functionality on Cardano, including user interface and features.
ms.criteria:
・Delivery of the fully open-source BACC for Cardano (adapter) project licensed under AGPLv3.
・Project Closeout Report must comprehensively cover all aspects of the project, from initiation to completion.
・Project Closeout Video should clearly demonstrate the successful integration and functionality of BACC on Cardano.
